text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Now that Tachyon isn't here, there isn't a 
single shred of a reason I'd lose!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: The strongest is... me!?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "I can do it tooooo!! HYAAAAAAAH!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Dants, it's Dants, Dants Flame! This 
year's Derby Umamusume is Dants Flame!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her archrival gone, the one who stood 
in the way of Jungle Pocket's ambition 
was, unexpectedly, her close friend.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, well, can't be helped. Not when the 
opponent is Dants.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I could... let them have it...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Like hell that's fine!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ooo, Dantsu... Why you little, how dare 
you~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, congratulate me! Celebrate with me, 
Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Like hell I'm gonna celebrate!! I wanted 
to win this time more than anything!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
And yet... Gwaaah, that's so pathetic of 
me~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the relationship between Jungle 
Pocket and Dantsu Flame is gradually 
changing as well.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It's disappointing that we didn't win, 
but... thank you, Trainer-san."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Watching today's race helped clear my 
head a bit."

text_block_list.name: Older Brother
text_block_list.text: Yeah... thank you from me as well.
choice_data_list: No... I'm sorry. This was all I could do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I do have a few regrets. Even so, I was 
able to show Fuji Kiseki and my brother a 
wonderful sight."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Fuji-san...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Pokke...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Fuji...-san... I... I'm...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: My bad, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, as long as you gave it your 
all. Besides, the Classic Triple Crown 
isn't over yet."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that the festival of the Japan 
Derby is over, what's next...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: It's the Kikuka Sho, Pokke-chan!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's nail it, Dants. If we just 
keep building on what we've done so far...
choice_data_list:
Doing things the way we have been... might 
not be enough anymore.

Doing things like we have been... might 
not be enough anymore, huh?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why's that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Allow me to explain. The final leg of the 
Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho, is a 
3,000-meter long-distance race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is far more punishing than the medium 
distances up until now. On top of that, 
dedicated training is required.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well, I know it's long, but a race 
is a race, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't matter how many thousand meters it 
is, the strongest one wins in the end. 
Let's do this, Dantsu!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Yup. Ehehe~♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What's your deal? Wipe that smirk off your 
face.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Because~, I felt like you finally 
acknowledged me."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Pokke-chan's number one rival?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that all? Still... yeah, that's 
right. Right now, you're number one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The same day, Hokkaido—

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
You made it all the way to the Derby, 
Pocket...

text_block_list.name: Hokkaido Coach
text_block_list.text:
"You've gotten strong. However, if things 
continue like this..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we're gonna pump it up even more 
from here, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking ahead to the Kikuka Sho, we 
decided to focus our training this summer 
on long-distance preparation.
